svg.title: Confidential Containers Pod launch: five phases and four possible outcomes
svg.desc: A portrait sequence in five vertically stacked panels, read from top to bottom. Each panel repeats only the actors needed for that phase, with at most four lanes. The nine logical actors are CoCo IT, Kubernetes API and kubelet, containerd and Kata runtime, the confidential guest containing Kata Agent, Confidential Data Hub and Attestation Agent, private registry, Trustee KBS, Trustee AS, Trustee RVPS, and the NVFlare workload in that same guest. Phase A submits Pod YAML and boots the guest. Phase B validates InitData and fetches encrypted image artifacts. Phase C binds guest identity and launch context into CPU and required GPU evidence and appraises it against approved references. Phase D separately authorizes each exact protected resource and encrypts it to the attested guest key. Phase E verifies signatures, decrypts layers, and enforces guest policy before starting NVFlare. Four outcomes: startup failure, key-release denial, guest-request denial, and allowed change or successful launch. The actual image digest is not explicitly pinned by current guest Rego; a different validly signed same-repository image requires exact-digest binding and a negative test. Runtime aliases and unbound metadata may pass. This is a conceptual dependency sequence, not an exact RPC trace, whole-YAML hash, duplicate-prevention guarantee, or proof from Pod Running. Reviewed 2.9 baseline: SNP plus NVIDIA GPU. Extended CPU-only and TDX profiles describe companion PR #5344.
svg.text: CoCo Pod launch: five phases, four outcomes
Read down the page. Repeated guest and service names mean the same actors.
Only passing branches continue. Image pulls, attestation and resource requests may
interleave and repeat: this is a conceptual dependency sequence, not an exact RPC trace.
Trust boundaries: rose = untrusted host · green = confidential guest · blue = secure services.

g.text: A · Submit the Pod and boot the selected runtime
RuntimeClass selects an installed runtime handler.
It is not a separate service or an attested runtimeClassName string.
Missing handler, resources or reachability can stop startup.
Host-controlled failure is not a security guarantee.
B · Initialize the guest and fetch encrypted image artifacts
Check InitData against its CPU-attested binding; initialize guest policy.
A binding mismatch fails. Host YAML alone is not a trusted launch claim.
This is the same guest and launch context throughout the remaining panels.
Image policy and signing key use the resource round trips in phases C and D.
C · Bind and appraise the confidential guest’s evidence
7 · AA obtains CPU + required GPU evidence
Bind the guest key and InitData into the verified context.
The selected release profile determines whether GPU evidence is required.
AS appraises supplied CPU / GPU evidence, bindings and TCB.
KBS enforces the release-required evidence set.
Verifiers may use CPU / GPU vendor collateral and endorsement services.
D · Authorize each exact protected resource
Resources: image decryption key, signature public key and image policy.
An acceptable EAR alone does not authorize every resource.
Check the attested policy’s image / arguments and exact resource path.
This is not a check of the operator’s raw YAML or the live OCI request.
Failure in phase C or D denies release: invalid / unapproved evidence,
TCB, CPU / required GPU, wrong InitData or failed resource policy.
The confidential VM may already have booted.
encrypted to the attested guest key
E · Enforce the guest checks, then start NVFlare
Both actors are inside the SAME confidential guest
CDH / image path verifies signatures and decrypts image layers.
Kata Agent checks the actual OCI / process request against guest policy.
Key release and successful decryption alone do not start NVFlare.
Bad signature / ciphertext, or a request outside effective guest policy:
process, env, user, capabilities, mounts and other checked fields.
This does not mean that every edit to those fields is forbidden.
CURRENT LIMITATION · ACTUAL IMAGE DIGEST NOT PINNED
Guest Rego allows the CRI image-name annotation key, not a fixed value.
image_guest_pull has a source TODO; signatures use matchRepository.
A different validly signed same-repository image needs exact-digest
binding plus a negative test. It must still pass all other checks.
Rejection of every changed image is not demonstrated.
only after all effective checks pass
The unchanged intended Pod follows the same successful path.
A runtime alias selecting the same handler or unbound metadata may pass.
There is no whole-YAML hash or anti-duplication guarantee.
Key release ≠ process start. Pod Running ≠ trusted launch proof.

svg.text: Host denial of service remains possible; evidence and policy enforcement protect specific claims.
AA = Attestation Agent · CDH = Confidential Data Hub · KBS = Key Broker Service
AS = Attestation Service · RVPS = Reference Value Provider Service · EAR = Entity Attestation Result
OCI = Open Container Initiative runtime specification
Reviewed 2.9 baseline: SNP + GPU. Extended CPU-only / TDX profiles: companion PR #5344.
